intro: Beren's Peril is a Horde quest directed by Shadow Priest Allister from the Sepulcher. Agents of the Forsaken have caught wind of a hidden conclave of Scourge massing inside a secluded cave tucked into the southern Silverpine hills, aiming to strike them down before an offensive can begin.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: I have received reports that a group of undead are holing up to prepare for an attack against us. Armed with this information, we can turn the tables and attack them first, nipping their little plan in the bud.

Unfortunately, my information is spotty, at best. They are reported to be hiding in a location known as Beren's Peril. The exact location is unknown, but it appears to be a cave in the hills, near a pocket of Dalaran wizards.
I trust your resourcefulness. Find them, and put them down.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Have you located their base yet, friend? Time is of the essence!

clips.title: Completion
paras: If our scouts and agents continue to procure valuable information such as this, we shall have the Lich King's Scourge removed from our lands in no time.
